name: kugiri
title_zh: 浏览器在哪断行，它就在哪切词
tagline_zh: 不用猜标点、不用赌空格，拿到的是浏览器渲染后真实的行、词、字边界。做选区高亮、逐词翻译、按行复制。
tagline_en: No guessing punctuation or spaces—get the exact line, word, and character boundaries the browser rendered. For.
desc_en: Splits text into lines, words and characters exactly where the browser already broke it.
why_zh: 它读的是浏览器布局引擎的断行结果，不是正则瞎切。选区、逐词点击。
why_en: It reads the layout engine's actual break points, not regex guesses. Selections, word clicks, and line copies finally share the.
limit_zh: 只对浏览器已渲染的文本生效，不处理未插入 DOM 的字符串；断行依赖当前视口宽度和字体，改布局或缩放后结果会变。
limit_en: Only works on text already rendered in the DOM, not raw strings; results shift with viewport width and font; no cross-line merging or semantic word.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Split text where the browser already breaks it
